# Lychee

> Lychee is a food and cosmetic ingredient scanner for iOS and Android. Scan a barcode or ingredient label to understand processing, additives, allergens, nutrition, and cosmetic ingredient concerns.

Official website: https://lychee.fit/
Product facts reviewed: 2026-10-10. Publisher-maintained information.

A processing-first food scanner with personalized allergen checks and a separate beta cosmetic scoring model.

Free to download with core barcode scanning and product scores. Optional Lychee Premium unlocks additional analysis and features. The free experience may include ads; Premium includes ad-free scanning.

## Product references

- [Food scanner](https://lychee.fit/food-scanner/): Lychee scans packaged food barcodes and ingredient labels. See a processing-first score, additives, allergen information and available nutrition in one place, then compare your next purchase.
- [Cosmetic scanner](https://lychee.fit/cosmetic-scanner/): Scan cosmetics and personal-care products with Lychee to understand ingredient names, functions and concern categories. A separate beta score considers coverage and how the product is used.
- [Allergen checks](https://lychee.fit/allergen-scanner/): Lychee helps compare available ingredient, allergen and trace information with your selected profile. Use it to spot relevant label terms faster while keeping the current package as your reference.
- [Ingredient-label scanner](https://lychee.fit/ingredient-label-scanner/): Lychee uses OCR to read food and cosmetic ingredient paragraphs from a photograph. It can help when a barcode is missing or its database record does not include ingredients.
- [Processing-first scanning](https://lychee.fit/ultra-processed-food-scanner/): Use Lychee to inspect processing, ingredients and nutrition together. Its food score puts processing first, with NOVA data and ingredient-list evidence when available.
- [Additive scanner](https://lychee.fit/food-additive-scanner/): Lychee helps identify food additives and explain their role and concern context alongside the product’s processing and nutrition. Scan the barcode or a readable ingredient list.
- [Barcode scanning](https://lychee.fit/barcode-scanner-app/): Lychee turns food and cosmetic barcodes into available product ingredients, scores and explanations. It is free to download on iOS and Android, with optional Premium features.
- [INCI ingredient scanner](https://lychee.fit/cosmetic-ingredient-scanner/): Lychee reads cosmetic ingredient lists and explains recognized ingredient functions and concerns. Scan a product barcode or the ingredient paragraph to inspect the formula more easily.
- [Skincare scanner](https://lychee.fit/skincare-ingredient-scanner/): Scan skincare labels with Lychee to understand ingredient roles and concern categories. A rinse-off cleanser and a leave-on moisturizer use different exposure assumptions in the beta cosmetic score.
- [Scoring methodology](https://lychee.fit/methodology/): Lychee uses a processing-first food model and a separate beta cosmetic ingredient model. Both depend on the information available; a missing or uncertain label should not produce fake confidence.
- [Data sources](https://lychee.fit/data-sources/): Lychee’s barcode lookups use Open Food Facts and Open Beauty Facts. Label photos use OCR; scores use Lychee’s own logic. Public scientific and regulatory references provide context, not a live laboratory test.
- [Choosing a scanner](https://lychee.fit/best-food-scanner-app/): The most useful food scanner is one that explains the information you care about, recognizes the products you buy and makes its limits clear. Here is how to decide whether Lychee fits your shopping habits.
- [Lychee vs Yuka](https://lychee.fit/lychee-vs-yuka/): Both Lychee and Yuka scan food and cosmetics. The clearest difference is how they approach food scoring: Lychee puts processing first; Yuka publishes a method built around nutrition, additives and organic status.
- [About Lychee](https://lychee.fit/about/): Lychee helps people understand everyday product labels: food processing, additives, allergens, nutrition and cosmetic ingredients. It is independently developed by Maksym Horoszczak for iOS and Android.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://lychee.fit/faq/): Find out what Lychee scans, how the food and beta cosmetic models work, what happens when product data is missing, and what optional Premium adds.
- [Lychee facts](https://lychee.fit/app-facts/): Lychee is a food and cosmetic ingredient scanner for iOS and Android. Scan a barcode or ingredient label to understand processing, additives, allergens, nutrition, and cosmetic ingredient concerns.
- [Get Lychee](https://lychee.fit/download/): Download Lychee for iOS or Android from the official store links below. Start with food barcode scanning and explore ingredient checks, cosmetic analysis and your saved products.
- [Press and media](https://lychee.fit/press/): Descriptions, official product links and downloadable brand assets for journalists, reviewers and directory editors. Lychee is a processing-first food scanner with personalized ingredient checks and separate beta cosmetic analysis.

Lychee provides educational label information, not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment or a guarantee of product safety.
